hero.intro: I lead the full software development lifecycle — from requirements analysis and system design to CI/CD deployment and maintenance — building enterprise systems with Laravel, Vue, React, and Python, and delivering custom Odoo ERP solutions and training for clients.

services.name: Full-Stack Engineering
services.description: Enterprise web applications built end to end with PHP (Laravel), Vue.js, React.js, Inertia.js, and TypeScript on MySQL and PostgreSQL — from REST APIs to audit trails, dynamic email engines, telephony/SMS/email integrations, and SSO.

services.name: Odoo & ERP Consulting
services.description: Custom Odoo modules in Python and XML — Philippine Payroll, POS workflows, e-commerce restrictions, Appraisal, and HRIS — plus demos, workflow mapping, UAT, and corporate training on P2P, O2C, Inventory, and Accounting.

services.name: DevOps & Architecture
services.description: System architecture and delivery ownership: CI/CD pipelines, automated deployment strategy, server management, database performance, and Git-based workflows that keep production healthy.
